subject: Port SSE2 code to AVX2 & AVX512 (#47)
change_summary: Ports vector divide algorithms from SSE2 to AVX2 and AVX512.

units.name: Ports vector divide algorithms from SSE2 to AVX2 and AVX512.
units.evidence: All eight SSE2 raw targets prove bidirectionally. Six SSE2 public targets prove, and two signed branchfree targets prove under the generator-domain wrapper; all eight AVX512 lane-wise comparisons time out.

notes: The AVX2/AVX512 paths are the changed optimization and do not have a complete checker verdict.
